extracted.intended_audience: Agency Task Force members, CIA Directorate managers, and staff responsible for OMB Circular A-44 submissions and reports reduction
extracted.subtask_description: Interim progress reporting and implementation guidance for agency compliance with OMB Circular A-44 (reports reduction), including projected savings targets, program documentation, project-approval/process changes, and reporting reductions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned savings goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans Directorate expects to reach its assigned goal of $150,000 in savings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit monetary target for the Directorate to achieve through changes addressed in the submission responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country base programming documentation integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Country base programming - is a reality throughout all geographic divisions. Documentation has been compiled in time to become an integral part of their Program Submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Country-base programming documentation must be prepared and included within Program Submissions; projected implementation costs originally factored are accepted as valid and expended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management and approval system changes to realize savings
rubrics_metrics.description: The greatest area of savings was anticipated to accrue from changes in the project management and approval system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure changes using the provided statistical table of projects processed and levels of approval (FY1970–1973 figures). The decrease in Directorate-level review/approvals is a primary indicator of savings potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use specific cost-estimation formula for project actions
rubrics_metrics.description: If the cost of project actions is judged to be the sum of inventory items 15, 39 and 40 a dollar value of about [redacted] is obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cost of project actions should be computed by summing inventory items 15, 39, and 40; savings projections are derived by estimating the portion of these items that will be eliminated (e.g., one-half of item 15 and a percentage of items 39 and 40).

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate Directorate and Division savings as fractions of inventory costs
rubrics_metrics.description: The decrease in Directorate level review and approvals suggests that about one-half of item 15 and an additional [portion] within items 39 and 40 will be 'saved'. Divisions savings are reckoned as being about one-third their costs contained in items 39 and 40.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the stated fractions (half for Directorate item 15; one-third for Division items 39/40) when converting reductions in review/approval activity into dollar savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce component required reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: FE Division originally reported that it proposed to reduce component required reporting by about $80,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and eliminate or streamline component-required reports to realize projected savings; track actual versus projected progress (FE Division later reported only marginal progress).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce Vietnam ROIC reporting as a targeted savings source
rubrics_metrics.description: A savings of approximately [redacted] in reduced Vietnam ROIC reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target reductions in specific recurrent reporting (e.g., Vietnam ROIC) as a calculable source of savings; include these reductions in overall savings aggregation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregate savings by arithmetic combination of identified areas
rubrics_metrics.description: By subtracting 'a' (country base programming costs) from the sum of 'b' (project-management/approval savings) and 'c' (component reporting reductions) one arrives at a result approximating the mark assigned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute net savings as (b + c) - a per the memorandum's method to assess whether the Directorate meets assigned targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance flexibility in management of Professional Trainees
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant changes in management of Professional Trainees in RID have been promulgated to enhance flexibility in assignments and afford participants greater opportunity for meaningful employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modify trainee assignment and management policies to increase flexibility and promote meaningful work; treat management change as part of organizational measures contributing to overall efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate repetitious historical documentation in project outlines
rubrics_metrics.description: The DD/P has approved yet a further change designed to eliminate repetitious historical documentation in project outlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove or consolidate redundant historical material from project outlines to reduce paperwork burden and streamline submissions; consider this a procedural standard for project documentation.
